headline: Build secure multilingual products faster
summary: A reusable Go, Vue, and Astro foundation with runtime localization and permission-driven administration.
features_title: Three focused applications, one reliable suite
features_summary: Each application keeps its own version history while sharing immutable API contracts and release pins.
feature_api_body: Go and Gin with permission-driven authorization, runtime localization, and portable database boundaries.
feature_admin_body: Vue administration built around secure sessions, exact permissions, and accessible workflows.
feature_site_body: Astro SSR with locale URLs, semantic HTML, canonical links, hreflang, and structured data.
architecture_title: Independent repos. Explicit contracts. Predictable releases.
faq_language_question: Can the system add and edit more than two languages?
faq_language_answer: Yes. Locale availability and translated values come from the runtime API, so system operators can add languages and correct wording without changing application code.
faq_database_question: Which databases does the starter target?
faq_database_answer: PostgreSQL is the primary database. MariaDB, including XAMPP workflows, is a supported portability target, with separate evidence required before claiming support for other engines.
footer_note: A practical foundation for CMS, back-office, and future SaaS products.
